$comment: Self-derived finetype drift contract for census/naics_2022_titles, checked by the in-engine finetype_validate@1 gate (the model-free `ft_validate` DuckDB table macro). ft_validate MELTS every column to VARCHAR, so this contract uses ONLY the string-surviving JSON-Schema keywords. ENFORCED: the `pattern` on entry_id (a six-digit code, '|', a description) and on code (six digits), the shapes descriptor.overrides.json publishes; the closed `enum` on release and text_source; and `minLength`/`maxLength` envelopes on the text. NOT ENFORCED, by design: NULLs (invisible to ft_validate) and object-level `required` (documentation only); the title-index contract in ../../contracts/check_titles.sql refuses a NULL key, title, code or release. Free-text fields carry LOOSE length envelopes with headroom. Derived from build/stage/naics_2022_titles.parquet on Census's files of 2026-11-17 (the longest title 213 characters, the longest code title 118): a pass-through on today's rows, a fail-closed tripwire for future drift (a code that is not six digits, an entry_id of another shape, a release other than the edition).
title: census/naics_2022_titles
